verdict_text:
YES

The script skips exactly the 48 buffers (16 layers × 3) via a fullmatch on the buffer pattern, casts exactly the 64 listed projection matrices with `.float().to(torch.bfloat16)` (float16 → float32 → bfloat16, the round-to-nearest-even path the spec names), upcasts everything else to float32, leaves names untouched, and asserts all four required checks before writing — yielding 244 − 48 = 196 tensors. The only part I cannot verify from reading is `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`, which is passed the correct 268,435,456-byte limit and target directory but whose internal shard-packing and index generation are outside the artifact shown.
